title: FarConversations
tagline: Helps you strike conversations from people in your extended network and also find warm connects to them
description:
It works in three main steps
1. In the first one as soon as you click on get started, we create an embedded wallet for you + retrive all your information to run it through AI to find out more about your interests
2. When you click on Find someone, it uses the karma3labs api to find people in your second and third degree contact 
3. If you come across a profile that you want to develop a relation + strike a conversation with you can click on FarConversation, it will fetch all the casts made by that person and send you a AI starter line + also let you know about interests of that person.
how_its_made:
It uses
The main frame was entirely built on the frog framework
Apart from that it uses
1. Privy to generate the embedded wallet, where the idea for future is to airdrop these address with NFTs for being an early adopter of FarConversations + also do direct wallet to wallet messaging via their embedded wallet
2. It uses OpenAI API to create summaries and generate conversational starters
3. It uses Karma3Labs API for finding people from the extended network
4. Pinata API to generate warm connect leads + to fetch user details + to also fetch casts by users
